mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when RSAFS shows a 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% each in a single month signals a strong consumer demand and housing market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% each in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, which stabilizes the economy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases by more than 0.5% each in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a slowdown in economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.
